name: Document Editor
title: React Markdown document editor with visual and source views
description: A controlled React document editor with visual editing, Markdown source, preview and split views.

sections.heading: What does it store?
paragraphs: The editor uses portable Markdown. The host application owns the controlled document value, persistence and access permissions.

sections.heading: How do I install it?
paragraphs: Install the package and import its stylesheet. React and React DOM 18 or newer are required.

sections.heading: Can it collaborate?
paragraphs: An optional Yjs entry point is available. A production host must provide the collaboration transport, authentication and storage. Installing the editor alone does not provide a hosted collaboration service.

sections.heading: What is the playground?
paragraphs: The playground demonstrates the current source version. Its examples are separate from your production documents and may be newer than the published package.
